<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="photoGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EA5D6B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#EFC54D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="photoClip">
      <circle cx="195" cy="158" r="78"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="325" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="17" x2="335" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="349" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="351" y1="16" x2="355" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="366" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="31,63 22,72 31,81" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="23" y1="72" x2="45" y2="72" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="77" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Video Call</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="96" x2="370" y2="96" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- profile photo -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="158" r="84" fill="#F5F7FA" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="158" r="78" fill="url(#photoGradient)"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#photoClip)">
    <circle cx="220" cy="130" r="34" fill="#EFC54D" opacity="0.75"/>
    <polygon points="90,238 158,165 190,199 219,174 304,238" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <polygon points="135,238 187,183 244,238" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.75"/>
    <circle cx="158" cy="128" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.28"/>
    <path d="M142 173 Q195 120 248 173" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.45"/>
    <path d="M125 194 Q195 144 265 194" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="195" cy="158" r="78" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>

  <text x="195" y="273" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Maya, 27</text>
  <text x="195" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your match is waiting for you</text>

  <!-- pricing card shadow and card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="329" width="342" height="190" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="24" y="329" width="342" height="190" rx="18" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="48" y="363" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Before you start</text>
  <line x1="48" y1="378" x2="342" y2="378" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="48" y="411" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your account balance</text>
  <text x="342" y="411" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">$24.80</text>
  <line x1="48" y1="425" x2="342" y2="425" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="48" y="457" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Video call rate</text>
  <text x="342" y="457" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">$0.65 / min</text>
  <line x1="48" y1="471" x2="342" y2="471" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="48" y="503" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Estimated available time</text>
  <text x="342" y="503" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#96E063">38 min</text>

  <!-- information notice -->
  <rect x="24" y="541" width="342" height="58" rx="12" fill="#FFF4F7"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="570" r="10" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <text x="48" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
  <text x="68" y="565" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">You’ll be charged by the minute.</text>
  <text x="68" y="583" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">You can end the call whenever you like.</text>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="44" y="623" width="302" height="52" rx="26" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="44" y="623" width="302" height="52" rx="26" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <path d="M174 647 Q174 639 182 637 L182 644 Q188 640 193 647 Q195 650 195 654 Q195 646 201 644 L201 637 Q209 639 209 647 Q209 657 191 663 Q174 657 174 647 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="263" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">START VIDEO CALL</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="704" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your balance will update after the call.</text>
  <text x="195" y="726" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">Add balance</text>

  <!-- navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="762" width="390" height="82" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="762" x2="390" y2="762" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,787 50,777 62,787 62,800 38,800" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="35,788 50,774 65,788" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="50" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>

  <!-- matches -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="785" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="139" cy="785" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="798" x2="145" y2="798" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="133" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
  </g>

  <!-- call active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="786" r="23" fill="#FFF1F5"/>
    <rect x="185" y="778" width="20" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="191,792 195,797 198,792" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="785" r="2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="195" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">Calls</text>
  </g>

  <!-- messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="251" y="777" width="25" height="17" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="256,794 256,800 263,794" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="258" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="264" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="270" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="264" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Messages</text>
  </g>

  <!-- profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="337" cy="782" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="337" cy="797" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="337" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
